biggest_catch: It's income-qualified only, and an SCE-approved contractor decides which appliances you actually get after a home walkthrough — it's not a menu you order from.
catches: You must meet specific household income guidelines to be eligible.
An SCE-approved contractor does a home walkthrough and determines which appliances/services you qualify for — availability varies by home.
Offered first-come, first-served until funding is expended; the program may be modified or terminated without notice.
Certain restrictions (age, size, condition of the appliance/system being replaced) may apply; some services may not be available in all areas.
No dollar amounts are published — the value is free equipment and installation, framed as savings on appliances you'd otherwise buy.

c1.evidence: Southern California Edison — real operating California utility; official Energy Savings Assistance Program flyer on sce.com.

c2.evidence: Official SCE flyer: qualified income-eligible customers may receive refrigerator, freezer, clothes washer, dishwasher, heat-pump water heater, smart thermostat, cooling, lighting, and weatherization — appliances installed and services provided by approved contractors.

c3.evidence: No fee — program services and appliances are provided at no cost to qualified customers.

c4.evidence: Savings are realized immediately as free installed appliances/services — no cash payout timeline applies.

eligibility: SCE residential customer meeting household income guidelines. SCE-approved contractor walkthrough determines which appliances/services you qualify for. First-come, first-served until funding is expended.
notes: Verified from the official SCE ESA flyer (R-2247-V5-0823) 2026-09-22. No dollar amounts are published; the concrete value is free equipment plus professional installation. s3 passes because there is no waiting period — the benefit is delivered as installed appliances.
payout_quote: Qualified SCE customers may be eligible for free appliance upgrades and energy-saving services — including refrigerator, freezer, clothes washer, dishwasher, heat-pump water heater, smart thermostat, cooling, lighting, and weatherization — installed by SCE-approved contractors at no cost.

s1.note: SCE residential customer meeting household income guidelines; contractor walkthrough required.

s2.note: Contractor determines qualifying measures; funding-limited; program may change or end without notice.

s3.note: Benefit delivered as free installed appliances/services — no cash payout timeline applies.

s4.note: 'May be eligible' language is the official program wording; no dollar amounts are claimed.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: apply, income-qualify, contractor walkthrough, free installation.

steps: Apply for the Energy Savings Assistance Program at sce.com/esap or call 1-800-736-4777.
Meet the household income guidelines to qualify.
An SCE-approved contractor does a walkthrough of your home to determine which appliances or services you qualify for.
The contractor installs the approved appliances and provides the services at no cost to you.
timing: Free appliances installed and services provided at no cost after qualification — no cash payout timeline applies.

weasel_words.quote: 'May be eligible' / 'may qualify' — the official program wording; no dollar amounts are claimed.
